description: Call this when the user asks about perpetuals on Solana as a whole, which Solana perp DEX has the most open interest or volume, Pacifica markets (funding, open interest, 24h volume, mark) or how Jupiter compares with an order-book venue. Returns every venue summed and every market largest first, refreshed every 10 minutes; a venue filter and hourly history of one Pacifica market (up to 30 days) are optional. Jupiter-only detail (long versus short, utilization, JLP, top traders) is get_jupiter_perps.

history_days.description: Hourly history for the symbol, 1..30 days

symbol.description: Pacifica market symbol for hourly history, e.g. SOL or BTC

name: get_solana_perps
title: Solana Perps board: open interest, 24h volume and hourly rates across Solana perpetual venues (Jupiter, Pacifica)
